heard: There are more planets than stars in the night sky. We once believed our home galaxy held the entire universe. Edwin Hubble proved we're one galaxy among billions in the 1920s. Our barred spiral home holds over 100 billion stars. But our galaxy isn't a quiet collection of lonely suns. The Milky Way contains at least 100 billion planets.
